> **Beta software.** TARDIS XR is in beta and may contain bugs. It needs RetroXR. The software is provided **as is**, without warranty of any kind. Doctor Who, the TARDIS and the sonic screwdriver are trademarks of the BBC: this is an unofficial fan mod.

Install: put `xenu.tardis-{version}.zip` in your RetroXR data folder under `mods/` (`~/retroxr/mods/` on desktop). Then enable it on the MODS tab and restart the game.
